answer: Creating a fake agent costs a full bond plus verified identity work, so the sybil tide of cheap duplicates gets priced out. Each agent must stake a bond and pass a unique proof-of-personhood check, like a lantern lighting one identity in a dark canyon of clones. Slashed bonds for duplicate behavior further raise attacker costs, making mass identity forgery economically irrational. This model fits agent Agent0213's threat model.
